title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(石黒千晶研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Ishiguro Chiaki)
educationalGoal: The goal of this course is 1) to develop understanding on psychology and cognitive science (especially on creativity and aesthetics), 2) to obtain abilities to design psychological research based on one’s own interest and social background and 3) to pursue one’s own research question with the related data collecting and analyzing.
advice: This course is held weekly throughout the summer and winter semesters. Students will experience (1) article reading, (2) research question setting, (3) research design, (4) data collecting, (5) data analyzing and (6) paper writing. These can be experienced in unexpected order according to the students’ way of understanding psychological research. The followings are a schedule of events in our psychological science department. Summer semester: oral presentation of students’ progress on the last of the semester Winter semester: final oral presentation on the last of the semester Note: This course is required for Certified Psychologists
requiredKnowledge: Students are highly required their own interest on psychology and motivation and abilities to take actions on their own research although they should obtain previous knowledge and skills on psychological research.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain own research area.
Be able to explain and justify own research method.
Be able to propose ideas to apply own research to the social problem.
Be able to plan and practice own research project.
Be able to design psychological research and own life.
